Equipment:

Auxiliary Control/Lubricating Oil 
 Pump
BBC Germany
Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to performed 
every 8000 equivalent operating hours EOH as indicated in the title block.

The high pressure oil pump: floats the shaft of unit at turn on 
and turning on of unit.

The shaft turning or hydraulic pump: turn the shaft of the unit 
at turning on of unit.

The auxiliary control oil pump: generate the emergency and security oil at the 
beginning for turn on of the unit instead of the main gear pump

The auxiliary lubricating oil pump: pumping the oil 
at the beginning and stop for turn on of the unit instead of the main gear pump.

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued

The maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

items: A work permit must be issued

The maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Turbine must be shut down.

Fuel system ( solar gas ) of gas turbine out 
 of service.

Isolate the step up transformer and its 
 circuit breaker

Isolate the circuit breaker of all pump motors 
 and disconnect the electrical terminal of all pump motors
Fire fighting system must be out of service

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Complete maintenance tool set.
Oil bath
Clippers
Heater
Rags
Bearings: ( 7314 , uN314 ) / Bearings: ( 6209 , 6209 )

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

items:
Inspect the bearing of pump motor if it is not 
 good change it as follows:

Loose the face of motor and the case bearing 
 bolts.
Pull the motor face to out side.

Determine the direction of bearing 
 construction.
Pull the old bearing using clippers.

Install the new bearing using pressure and hot 
 oil path ( care the direction of bearing ).
Put grease for bearing case.
Install the face motor.
Retighten the case bearing bolts.
Retighten the motor face bolts.

Test the motor against rotation ( Manually 
 Electrical ).
